title: feat(spec,plugin-form)!: a form view's buttons hold submit and cancel only — buttons.reset is retired, because no form ever drew a reset button
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDeyq5DkFHhU9RodAzdP53y)_

Refs #27153
Ruling-ref: 6469111181

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file or hand-written docs page authors or teaches `buttons.reset` (0 hits at base); only the generated references move

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:表单视图 `buttons` 里的 `reset` 退役,写了会被拒并附改法。`buttons` 只剩 `submit` 和 `cancel`。ObjectForm 不再读 `buttons.reset.show`,ui 的 `ObjectFormSchema.buttons` 镜像同步去掉 `reset`。
- 为什么改:ADR-0049 声明即执行。六处表单按钮栏都只画提交和取消,从没有画过重置按钮,`reset.label` 无人读取;唯一读 `reset.show` 的地方把它当成"保存后清空表单",与"重置按钮"的含义不符。
- 风险与回滚:这是收窄,写了 `buttons.reset` 的元数据会被拒。本仓除两个测试夹具外没有任何生产者;已存的 `sys_metadata` 行读取时自动去掉该键,`os migrate meta --from 17` 改写源码。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` 的 `FORM_VIEW_BUTTONS_RESET_RETIRED` 改法文案;② `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` 的 `formViewButtonsResetRemoved`;③ `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` 删掉的那一行折叠。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project repo src/ui/form-view-buttons-reset-retirement.test.ts`,预期 22 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

### Spec (`@objectstack/spec`)

- `FormViewSchema.buttons.reset` is a `retiredKey()` tombstone inside the live, strict `buttons` block. Its prescription: "`view.form.buttons.reset` was removed in @objectstack/spec 18.3.0 (ADR-0049) — no form ever drew a reset button, and its label was never read. Delete the key: a form has `submit` and `cancel` buttons only, and Cancel leaves the form without saving. `reset.show: true` used to clear the form after each save (the ObjectForm fold that ObjectView and the record form page render); a form converted by this release no longer clears after a save, and a form that should declares `submitBehavior: { kind: 'continue' }`." followed by the `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence. `buttons.submit` and `buttons.cancel` are unchanged.
- **Behaviour after conversion (M1).** `reset.show: true` used to clear the form after each save, through the ObjectForm fold that ObjectView and the record form page render. A converted stored row no longer clears after a save. The D2 conversion does not map the key onto `submitBehavior`, because the row cannot say whether the author wanted the clear. The prescription, the D3 `replacement` and `reason`, the conversion docblock and summary, the STEP18 rationale fragment and the changeset's FROM → TO line now all say this. They name `submitBehavior: { kind: 'continue' }`, which ObjectForm and the console `FormPage` honour, for an author who wants the clear.
- ADR-0087 kit (`spec-property-retirement`, key-tombstone route):
  - **D2 is owed**, so it ships: the block accepted `reset` through 18.2.0 and `PUT /meta/view` persists form views, so a stored `view` row can carry the key. Conversion `form-view-buttons-reset-removed` (`retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'`, MAJOR_18 order 79) strips `reset` from every form payload's `buttons`: a container's `form` and `formViews.*`, a form view item's `config`, a flattened form overlay, and the assembled `viewItems` channel. A block that held only `reset` stays an empty block. Its fixture has 4 notices.
  - D3 semantic entry `ui-form-view-buttons-reset-retired` (its `conversionIds` names the conversion), plus a STEP18_RATIONALE fragment.
  - One `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` row: `ui/FormView:buttons.reset` (a nested key of an inline block, so no `authorable-surface/` line of its own).
  - Removal-version pin: one JOIN row (the tombstone).
- Liveness (`liveness/view.json`): the `props/form/children/buttons` row stays `live` for `submit` / `cancel`, and its note no longer claims `reset` folds. It records the removal and the measurement, because sub-keys cannot be drilled.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` and `references/api/protocol.mdx`. `authorable-surface`, `api-surface`, `react-blocks.md` and `skills/**` are byte-identical (`buttons` is not in the React `ObjectForm` block's `dataProps`).

### Renderer (`@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/types`): the reader of the refused key, in the same PR

- `ObjectForm.foldFormButtons` no longer folds `buttons.reset.show` onto `showReset`. That fold was the key's only reader, and it landed on `resetOnSubmit` (clear the form after a save), not on a button. The fold's comment no longer lists `reset` among the structured `buttons` keys.
- The hand-written `ObjectFormSchema.buttons` mirror drops `reset` in both the TypeScript type (`types/src/objectql.ts`) and the zod mirror (`types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`), so the ui side no longer offers a key nothing reads.
- The ui types fixture `object-form-unmirrored-members-6152.test.ts` now uses `cancel` where it used `reset`.
- Comment-only: `FormPage.readFormButton`, `resolveFormViewChrome` and the plugin-form fold test header no longer describe `reset` as an unread key.
- **Not touched:** the flat `showReset` prop and its `resetOnSubmit` mapping. That is the block contract's own defect (`component.zod.ts` and `react-blocks.ts` describe it as "Show the reset button"), filed by the seat as #27247.

## Why

#27153 asked for enforce-or-remove on `buttons.reset` under ADR-0049. Measured at `origin/main` `fbe344b3`, six separate button bars draw a form's submit and cancel: the components form action bar (simple, sectioned, tabbed and split ObjectForm), console `FormPage`, the `ModalForm` and `DrawerForm` footers, `WizardForm` and `MasterDetailForm`. None of them draws a reset button. Two of them would need a semantic decision before one could (whether the wizard resets the step or the whole wizard, and whether master-detail resets line items). In-repo producers: 0 outside two test fixtures. Seat 1 ruled **retire** (claim 6469111181).

## Tests

- New pin `packages/spec/src/ui/form-view-buttons-reset-retirement.test.ts` (22 tests, `repo` project, added to `vitest.repo-tests.json`):
  - five doors refuse `buttons.reset` (with `show: true`, `show: false`, a label, and empty) at `…buttons.reset`, with the prescription's first sentence and the migrate sentence. The doors are `FormViewSchema`, `view.form`, `view.formViews.*`, a ViewItem form record and the flattened form overlay;
  - the five doors still accept `submit` and `cancel`;
  - a control: an unknown button keeps the strict block's `unrecognized_keys`, not "was removed";
  - `defineStack` refuses with `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422 at `views.0.formViews.quick.buttons.reset`;
  - a `@ts-expect-error` at the authoring site;
  - the conversion over a stored view container and a stored form view item, its idempotence, its absence from the load path, its step-18 wiring and its D3 entry;
  - a tree-scoped absence walk with an anti-vacuity matcher test. As a probe, I wrote a temporary `packages/spec/src/ui/zz-probe-27153.ts` authoring `buttons: { submit: {}, reset: { show: true } }`; the walk named it (1 failed), and the probe was removed with a trap.
- `view.test.ts`: the buttons block test drops `reset`, and a new case pins the tombstone.
- `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`: JOIN row.

## Acceptance notes

- **Producer census, at base `fbe344b3`:** `buttons.reset` was authored by 0 files in `examples/`, platform sources, `skills/**`, Studio `*.form.ts` and ui examples. Two test fixtures authored it: spec `view.test.ts:3222` and ui types `object-form-unmirrored-members-6152.test.ts:112`, both moved here. **hotcrm, measured** on a public shallow clone at `353dace` (1055 tracked files, at 2026-10-28T08:39Z): 0 files author a `buttons: {` block at all, and no `reset:` key appears outside a `package.json` script name. If a hotcrm source authored after that commit carries the key, it is refused at parse with the prescription, `os migrate meta --from 17 --write` deletes it, and a stored row is converted on read.
- **Kept, as stated in the claim:** `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth` stay. They retire with #27159, which owns the React `ObjectForm` block contract; hence `Refs #27153`, not `Fixes`.
- **Install note:** the worktree install ran with `--ignore-scripts`, because the `better-sqlite3` header download from nodejs.org was cut off twice. Its shipped `prebuilds/linux-x64.node` loads (`select 1` answered), so nothing measured here depended on the skipped script.

## Verification

Head: `a443f1228`. It is `f101f23dd` plus `3684cdf07` (review 6471309095 round 2: M1, S2, and the `conversions-major18-merge` placement fix, which moves `formViewButtonsResetRemoved` directly above `formViewOptionDefaultRemoved`), a merge of `origin/main` at `696ee79f5` (made with `os-regen-merge.sh`), and the `protocol.mdx` regeneration it owed. On the merged tree: the spec build, `check:generated` (14/14), the spec suite (749 files, 22381 tests passed), and `test:repo` at 1376 of 1377. The one failure is `def-key-collisions.test.ts`: its sandbox copy cannot find tsx's `cli.mjs` because this worktree was installed with `--ignore-scripts`; it passed in CI on `f101f23dd`.
